headline: Economy ministry urges industry to bet on Mexican suppliers and substitute imports
summary: Mexico's deputy economy minister Ximena Escobedo said traditional tariff-free trade rules will not return. She urged domestic industry to coordinate on local suppliers and import substitution.
why: USMCA is the trade agreement linking Mexico, the US and Canada, and shifts in its rules affect sourcing, tariffs and supply chains for manufacturers.
original_headline: Economía urge a la industria a apostar por la proveeduría mexicana y sustituir importaciones
